name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
accessNote: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is a multicombat Wilderness area with player killing risk. Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of Fremennik Diary completion. Bloodveld access is closer through the Trollheim Agility shortcut with 64 Agility; God Wars followers are aggressive without god item protection. Cannon nuance: a cannon can physically be set up but GWD inhabitants may destroy it (Dwarf multicannon pageid 13551); wiki task tables split on the verdict, so trust the per-task row here.
